champion.tips: KARTHUS TIPS AND TRICKS Farm with Q in the early game to make it easier for your to pick up CS. Deactivate your Defile E once the skirmish has finished as it will eat through your mana bar. Keep an eye on the minimap at all times and use your R to pick up kills on low health.
champion.builds: THE BEST KARTHUS BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Karthus Bot build, you should take Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Presence of Mind and Last Stand in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blackfire Torch as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Shadowflame. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 55.0% winrate over 2 292 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells, with runes being First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blackfire Torch as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Shadowflame as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and Liandry's Torment. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 51.4% win rate across 74 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Karthus Bot build in the current patch, try Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells, Summon Aery, Axiom Arcanist, Transcendence and Scorch as your primary rune tree, and Presence of Mind with Last Stand as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blackfire Torch as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Shadowflame as third item. The last 3 options are Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and Horizon Focus. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.0% win rate over 62 matches played. Situational Karthus Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Karthus build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Karthus runes page.
